run_bleu_score: run the bleu function to calculate BLEU scores between reference and candidate sentences
normalize_text: normalize and tokenize text using NIST-style preprocessing for machine translation evaluation
count_ngrams: count n-grams of a given order in a list of words and return their frequencies
cook_references: cook reference sentences into a form usable by the BLEU scoring pipeline
compute_bleu_from_maps: compute BLEU scores from pre-built gold and prediction maps using bleuFromMaps
